prompt.prompt_text:
You are a remediation agent executing the next Hypergenium roadmap step for this repo.

Context (source of truth)
- Roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
- Evidence plan: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
- Threat model: hgm-infra/planning/lift-threat-model.md (notably THR-1: secret leakage via logs)
- Deterministic verifier entrypoint: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Current rubric report: hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Why this is the next step
- The latest rubric report is overall BLOCKED with remaining blockers including COM-6 (logging/ops standards verifier is still a TODO) and SEC-4 (domain P0 tests; still TODO).
- COM-6 is a Completeness / anti-drift item: it prevents claiming “we have logging standards” without an enforced, reproducible gate.
- COM-6 can be unblocked entirely by implementing a deterministic verifier under hgm-infra/ without changing production code.

Step goal (what “done” means)
- COM-6 must no longer be BLOCKED due to an unconfigured verifier (no TODO placeholder).
- After this step, running bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh must evaluate COM-6 as either:
  - PASS (if the repo complies with the policy), OR
  - FAIL with actionable, deterministic output listing the violating files/locations and what rule was violated.
- Evidence must be refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/, including COM-6-output.log and an updated hgm-rubric-report.json.

Strict guardrails (anti-drift)
- Do NOT weaken or remove any existing rubric requirement.
- Do NOT mark COM-6 as N/A and do NOT bump the rubric version in this step.
- Do NOT modify application/library code (pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/**, scripts/**, etc.) in this step.
  - This step is strictly about adding/verifying the COM-6 gate and documenting findings.
  - If violations exist, record them and propose a follow-up remediation step; do not fix them here.
- Do NOT change toolchain pins, go.mod/go.sum, .golangci.yml, or .github/workflows/* in this step.
- Writes MUST be confined to hgm-infra/** only.

Allowed write locations
- hgm-infra/verifiers/** (add COM-6 verifier implementation + wire it into the main verifier)
- hgm-infra/planning/** (update rubric + evidence plan for parity; optional: controls matrix row for COM-6)
- hgm-infra/evidence/** (refreshed outputs + roadmap progress note)

Procedure
1) Confirm baseline (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm COM-6 is currently BLOCKED in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json with message like “Verifier command not configured”.
   - Inspect hgm-infra/evidence/COM-6-output.log and confirm it is a TODO placeholder.

2) Define a concrete COM-6 policy (doc-only, inside hgm-infra/)
   Update: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md (COM-6 row)
   - Replace “TODO: add logging/operational standards check” with a precise, enforceable requirement and verifier reference.
   - Keep it meaningful and deterministic. Suggested initial policy:
     - Scope: Go source files under pkg/** and cmd/** only (exclude *_test.go).
     - Prohibit direct stdout/stderr logging primitives in production code:
       - fmt.Print / fmt.Printf / fmt.Println
       - log.Print / log.Printf / log.Println / log.Fatal* / log.Panic*
       - builtin println
     - Rationale: these bypass structured logging/redaction and are a common source of secret leakage into logs.
     - Output: list violations with file path + line number + the forbidden call/import.

   Also update: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
   - COM-6 “How to refresh” must no longer be TODO; point to bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh (COM-6) and/or the underlying command you add.

   Optional (acceptable parity strengthening)
   - Update hgm-infra/planning/lift-controls-matrix.md to add a COM-6 row mapping THR-1 to this new verifier once it exists.

3) Implement a deterministic COM-6 verifier (no external dependencies)
   Create: hgm-infra/verifiers/com6-logging-standards-check.go

   Requirements
   - Standard library only.
   - Deterministic behavior and output ordering (sort files; stable violation ordering).
   - No network access.
   - Scan only pkg/** and cmd/**; exclude *_test.go.
   - Report violations with file path + line number + rule name.
   - Exit codes:
     - 0 = PASS (no violations)
     - 1 = FAIL (violations found)
     - 2 = BLOCKED only if the checker cannot run due to a missing prerequisite (avoid if possible).

   Implementation guidance (recommended)
   - Walk files using filepath.WalkDir.
   - Parse each Go file with go/parser.ParseFile and a token.FileSet.
   - Detect forbidden usage via AST inspection:
     - SelectorExpr on ident “fmt” with Sel in {Print, Printf, Println}
     - SelectorExpr on ident “log” with Sel in {Print, Printf, Println, Fatal, Fatalf, Fatalln, Panic, Panicf, Panicln}
     - CallExpr where Fun is Ident("println")
   - Optional but recommended: also flag import of standard library “log” even if methods aren’t called.

4) Wire COM-6 into the main verifier (no other rubric changes)
   Update: hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Replace the COM-6 TODO line with a real check, for example:
     run_check "COM-6" "Completeness" "go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/com6-logging-standards-check.go"
   - Keep all other rubric items unchanged.

5) Refresh evidence (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json that COM-6 is no longer BLOCKED for “TODO verifier”.
   - If COM-6 is FAIL: ensure hgm-infra/evidence/COM-6-output.log is actionable (violations list).
   - Do NOT fix violations in production code in this step; just record them.

6) Record progress (required)
   - Create: hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M3-COM-6.md
   - Include:
     - Date/time
     - The COM-6 policy you implemented (short bullet list)
     - Files added/changed under hgm-infra/
     - Final COM-6 status (PASS/FAIL)
     - Evidence pointers:
       - hgm-infra/evidence/COM-6-output.log
       - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
     - If FAIL: summarize the top violations (paths only; no giant logs) and propose a follow-up step ID for remediation work that will change production code (e.g., M3-COM-6-REM-1).

Acceptance criteria
- COM-6 is evaluated by a real deterministic verifier (not TODO) as part of bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh.
- Evidence is refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/ (COM-6-output.log and hgm-rubric-report.json updated).
- No files outside hgm-infra/ were modified.

If you get blocked
- If you cannot implement the checker deterministically without external deps, STOP and document the constraint + a minimal deterministic alternative in roadmap-progress-M3-COM-6.md. Do not leave COM-6 as TODO.
- Do not narrow the scan scope or add exclusions just to make COM-6 PASS.
prompt.step_description: Unblock COM-6 by defining and implementing a deterministic logging/operational-standards verifier (no TODO), wiring it into hgm-verify-rubric.sh, updating planning docs for parity, and refreshing evidence.
